experiments.reason: Marked infeasible by the Experiment Planner: The hypothesis requires time-to-event data with censoring and evaluation using time-dependent AUC, which cannot be meaningfully tested on the provided datasets. None of the listed datasets contain survival time data with censoring indicators or patient follow-up times that vary between individuals. The closest match is the 'historical_stock_market_daily_closing_price_financial_data.csv', but it lacks patient-level survival outcomes and censoring. To make this feasible, we simplify the hypothesis to test whether survival models (using Cox regression) perform better than binary classifiers (logistic regression) on a synthetic survival dataset generated to mimic hospital readmission patterns, while varying time horizons for evaluation. This allows us to test the core idea without requiring real-world readmission data.
